title: 第二十五章 三件废物补开丹祖炉第二十六章 守炉道取丹者焚
slug: 天赋每周一刷新从变废为宝开始成仙
content_zh:
三件残物同时震动时，徐少阳终于按不住胸口炉钉。
“少废话！周荒，你不是想要丹祖炉吗？门就在这里，怎么，不敢开？”
周荒神色不变。
“你这么急，我反倒不急了。”
徐少阳眼里闪过杀意，却没有立刻动手。
显然乌先生交代过，在门开之前，不能杀周荒。
许鸦留下的黑炉暗桩和陈骨一脉的人都在外圈沉默等待，像一群闻见血味却不敢先扑的野狗。
周荒看向半塌石门。
趋吉避凶已经乱成一团。
青黑废丹珠靠近圆形凹痕时，金光一闪，又立刻被黑光缠住；残破丹令贴向令牌凹痕，石门内部传出低沉炉鸣；乌鳞残剑指向剑痕凹槽，断口处新嵌的守炉剑鳞一片片翘起。
三件残物都在催他。
可越是这样，越要稳。
周荒没有一次性放入三件东西。
他先把青黑废丹珠按入圆形凹痕。
轰。
石门内黑烟一收，像被废丹珠吞了一口。
紧接着，他将残破丹令贴入令牌凹痕。
守炉二字亮起，石门上的古纹从死寂变为流动。
最后，周荒握住乌鳞残剑。
残剑刚靠近剑痕凹槽，一股黑火便从凹槽里喷出，直冲周荒面门。

徐少阳眼睛一亮。
“烧死他！”
周荒没有退。
他运转青木炎诀，以火木双灵根护住经脉，同时把剑锋往下一压。
“你断了这么多年，不就是等这一刻吗？”
乌鳞残剑发出低哑剑鸣。
刹那间，断剑钉入凹槽。
黑火被生生压回石门。
三件残物同时亮起。
这一刻，它们不再像三件临时拼来的道具。青黑废丹珠、残破丹令、乌鳞残剑，本就是青丹殿旧炉门散出去的三块残骨。
青黑废丹珠承废气。
残破丹令稳炉纹。
乌鳞残剑镇火线。
这不是开门那么简单。
是在用三件废物，临时补一座破了很多年的炉门。
原本到处乱窜的黑烟、尸气、残阵碎响，全像被压进炉底。
只剩一声又一声炉鸣。
咚。
咚。
咚。

每一声，都敲在众人心口。
外围黑炉修士开始躁动，有人忍不住往前踏了一步。
那人刚越过顾清寒之前划下的剑痕，石门上便射出一道黑火。
黑火没有烧他皮肉，而是直接钻入他袖中的丹器。
content_en:
When the three remnants shook at the same time, Xu Shaoyang finally couldn't hold the nail on his chest anymore.
"Stop talking nonsense! Zhou Huang, don't you want the Alchemy Furnace? The door is right here, why don't you dare to open it?"
Zhou Huang's expression remained unchanged.
"You are so anxious, but I am not anxious anymore."
Xu Shaoyang's eyes flashed with murderous intent, but he did not take action immediately.
Apparently Mr. Wu had told him not to kill Zhou Huang before the door was opened.
The black furnace stump left by Xu Ya and the people of Chen Gu's lineage were waiting silently in the outer circle, like a group of wild dogs that smelled blood but didn't dare to pounce first.
Zhou Huang looked at the half-collapsed stone door.
Seeking good fortune and avoiding misfortune has become a mess.
When the green and black waste pill bead approached the circular indentation, golden light flashed, and was immediately entangled in black light; the broken pill order was pressed against the indentation of the token, and a low furnace roar came from inside the stone door; the black-scaled broken sword pointed at the groove of the sword mark, and the scales of the newly embedded furnace sword at the break were raised.
All three remnants urged him.
But the more this happens, the more stable it is.
Zhou Huang didn't put in three things at once.
He first pressed the blue and black waste pill beads into the circular indentation.
boom.
The black smoke inside the stone gate cleared up, as if a waste pill had been swallowed.
Immediately afterwards, he pasted the Broken Pill Token into the indentation of the token.
The word "Shou Lu" lights up, and the ancient patterns on the stone door change from dead to flowing.
Finally, Zhou Huang held the Black Scale Broken Sword.
As soon as the broken sword came close to the groove of the sword mark, a stream of black fire spurted out from the groove and rushed straight to Zhou Huang's front door.
Xu Shaoyang's eyes lit up.
"Burn him!"
Zhou Huang did not retreat.
He used the Green Wood Flame Technique to protect his meridians with the dual spiritual roots of fire and wood, and at the same time pressed the sword's edge downwards.
"You've been off work for so many years, aren't you just waiting for this moment?"
The black-scaled broken sword made a low-pitched sword sound.
In an instant, the broken sword was nailed into the groove.
The black fire was pressed back to the stone door.
Three remnants lighted up at the same time.
At this moment, they no longer looked like three improvised props. The green and black waste pill beads, the broken pill order, and the black scale broken sword were originally the three broken bones scattered out of the old furnace door of the blue pill palace.
Green and black waste pills absorb waste gas.
The Broken Pill Order stabilizes the furnace pattern.
The black-scaled broken sword suppresses the fire line.
It’s not as simple as opening the door.
They are using three pieces of waste to temporarily repair a furnace door that has been broken for many years.
The black smoke, corpse aura, and shattering sounds that were originally flying everywhere seemed to have been forced into the bottom of the furnace.
There was only one sound after another.
Boom.
Boom.
Boom.
Every sound struck everyone's heart.
The black furnace monks outside began to become restless, and some couldn't help but take a step forward.
As soon as the man crossed the sword mark Gu Qinghan had made before, a black fire shot out from the stone door.
The black fire did not burn his flesh, but penetrated directly into the alchemy weapon in his sleeve.
